name: Elemental Vigor (Mythic)
body:
Your life force is strictly tied to the power of the elements.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Vigor.

Benefit: The temporary hit points and +10 foot speed bonus granted by Elemental Vigor persist for 1 round per mythic tier you possess after you dismiss your elemental form.
